metadata.title: INS Food Additives — Source Classification Dataset
important: INS is an identification/naming system, not a safety or approval rating.
Source category describes origin/manufacturing route, not healthfulness.
Commercial manufacturing route can vary by producer and jurisdiction.
Group INS numbers and subentries are retained separately where present in the baseline corpus.
This baseline should be reconciled against the current Codex CXG 36-1989 revision before production use.
